groups.sub: or Corpus nodes of Veil Proxima
groups.activity: Empyrean: board the Derelict Freightlinker and hack the terminal
conditions: Parts come from the Abandoned Derelict cache (rotation B), not the main mission reward table. The cache pays at mission completion, so do not abandon the run after hacking.
Grineer Veil nodes have no Carmine Penta parts. Nothing pities or guarantees a part, and players report weeks without one.
bonuses: The same cache rolls Axi relics for the Nyx, Valkyr, Hikou, Scindo, Cernos and Venka Prime sets, plus Endo and mods.

disclosures.title: nodes and rotation
disclosures.body: Pluto Proxima nodes: Khufu Envoy, Seven Sirens, Obol Crossing, Fenton's Field, Profit Margin, Peregrine Axis. Corpus Veil Proxima nodes: Calabash, Numina, Arc Silver, Erato, Lu-Yan, Sabmir Cloud. All use the same cache table, and Corpus derelicts always spawn. The cache is independent of the mission objective, so pick the shortest mission type.
